Property.name: TuxedoService
Property.Description: Mode of communication to Tuxedo Service

Property.name: DrcUser
Property.Description: User to get the report date from CDR drc tables

Property.name: MaxRetryCount
Property.Description: how many times have we retried?

Property.name: InitStorage
Property.Description: Max Storage (in KiloBytes). Max that can allowcated to a process is 2147483647 KB. If you change this value, You meed to recycle the components.

Property.name: MinStorage
Property.Description: Min Storage (in KiloBytes). If the storage level reached less than 100KB, the process will run out of storage.

Property.name: WarnStorage
Property.Description: Warn Storage (in KiloBytes). The available storage is less. Very soon you may reach MINIMUM storage. If you change the value to -1, it will stop sending the warning alerts.

do ##super() $$$TRACE("$$$$$ Inside OnInit() method...") #dim status as %Status set status = $$$OK $$$TRACE("IHC.ITF.Operation.OpCdrAndInitiateDemogrDrcDuplicates. OnInit.. Load JarFile "_ ..JarFiles) Set p=1
For { Set piece=$P(..JarFiles,":",p) Quit:piece="" set p = p+1 try { Set status= ..JavaGateway.%Import(piece) $$$TRACE("Jar file: " _ piece _ ", status: " _ status) } catch err { $$$TRACE(" Exception in jar file import....Err Data: "_err.Data_" Err Code:"_err.Code_" Err Status: "_err.AsStatus()) Set status = err.AsStatus() Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ProcessError(err.AsStatus()) } } $$$TRACE("BaseOperation OnInit status: " _ status) return status

" _ reportDate) set pstatus=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ItfLookup("IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.InitiateDemogrXmlToCdrEmpiInvestigator.InitiateMpiProperties","INITIATE_HOST_USER",.retVal) set iniHostUser = retVal set pstatus=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ItfLookup("IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.InitiateDemogrXmlToCdrEmpiInvestigator.InitiateMpiProperties","INITIATE_HOST_NAME",.retVal) set iniHostName = retVal set pstatus=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ItfLookup("IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.InitiateDemogrXmlToCdrEmpiInvestigator.InitiateMpiProperties","INITIATE_HOST_PASSWORD",.retVal) set iniHostPwd = retVal set pstatus=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ItfLookup("IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.InitiateDemogrXmlToCdrEmpiInvestigator.InitiateMpiProperties","INITIATE_HOST_PORT",.retVal) set iniHostPort = retVal $$$TRACE("IniHostPort " _ iniHostPort)
$$$TRACE(" Processing and updating DRC tables. Please wait..... " ) Set tmpstream = ##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New() //set output = objCdrTuxService.createContext(reportDate,iniHostUser,iniHostPwd,iniHostName,iniHostPort) set output = objCdrTuxService.createContext(reportDate,iniHostUser,iniHostPwd,iniHostName,iniHostPort) $$$TRACE("Class: " _ $classname(output)) Do tmpstream.Write(output) Do tmpstream.%Save()
$$$TRACE(" Processing and updating DRC tables Complete. "_output)
Set pResponse = ##class(Ens.StreamContainer).%New(tmpstream) set respMsg = pResponse.Stream.Read() $$$TRACE("OpCdrAndInitiateDemogrDrcDuplicates (Response): <" _ respMsg _ ">")
}catch err{ $$$TRACE(" Error during Tuxedo call....Error: "_err_" Err Data: "_err.Data_" Err Code:"_err.Code_" Err Status: "_err.AsStatus()) Set status = err.AsStatus() Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).ProcessError(err.AsStatus())
}
$$$TRACE("OnMessage(OpCdrAndInitiateDemogrDrcDuplicates) status: " _ status)
